story_text: As a staff member, I want confirming an already-cancelled booking to return an error so that invalid state transitions are blocked.

positive.title: Confirm a cancelled booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Fill in with a cancelled booking ID
positive.expected_result: An error message stating that state of this booking can't change

positive.title: Validate the error message clearly states the booking is already cancelled
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Fill in with a cancelled booking ID
positive.expected_result: An error message stating that state of this booking can't change

negative.title: Confirm an already confirmed booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Fill in with a confirmed booking ID
negative.expected_result: An error message stating that state of this booking can't change

edge.title: Confirming a booking that was confirmed, then cancelled, then confirmed again
steps: 1. Navigate to the cancel booking endpoint
2. Fill in with a confirmed booking ID
4. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
5. Fill in with the recenlty cancelled booking ID
edge.expected_result: An error message stating that state of this booking can't change
